test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-5) Official Paper (Held On: 12 June 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Six people A, B, C, D, E and F are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. C sits second to the left of B. E is an immediate neighbour of B. F sits third to the left of E. D sits second to the left of A.

Who sits to the immediate right of A ?
solution:
Six people A, B, C, D, E and F are sitting around a circular table facing the centre.

1) C sits second to the left of B.

2) E is an immediate neighbour of B.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b0efaedd890c5da200251bbc2d2238297ac7dda299fb3dc4e2a15901051f2863.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4ca46e0e5ce2c58e6241b1686ceea306918152ee8b13e9ad81a8fe426a75f8ce.png] 

3) F sits third to the left of E.

**In case - II C is already sitting third to the left of E so case - II is not possible.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c17a466bc782005e6149df7bace6e94beae6a73129d9c2daf2b349e9255476e5.png] 

4) D sits second to the left of A.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c4ca396930c21eb6e22b15864186149318e4cc6041b89916232d6a85dfc4454b.png] 

Thus, “C” sits to the immediate right of A.
